entries.label: We look for evidence of exceptional ability. Please provide us with 3-4 examples highlighting your exceptional ability, using quantitative metrics to display the impact on a product/project related to the requirements of the position you are applying for. Each bullet should be very concise— no longer than 3-4 sentences each and should capture the problem, solution, and result. We recommend starting with an action word (designed, led, built, promoted, launched, created, etc.) and be sure to include technical detail. This is your moment to WOW us! NOTE: Answering this question fully is the most important part of our interview process. First example:
entries.value: Built and shipped ClarityAtlas, an iOS health product, end to end in Swift, SwiftUI, and Supabase as co-founder and technical lead of Open Health Intelligence. The hard problem was estimating sleep without requiring a wearable, so I built a passive sleep-estimation system from phone-interaction and motion signals using HealthKit and Core Motion inputs like step count, gait speed, and movement patterns, plus a "Sleep Twins" backend that matches users on standardized behavioral features with weighted distance. We ran a live pilot at Johns Hopkins with 30+ users, were selected for the Johns Hopkins Pava Spark Accelerator and NSF I-Corps, and presented to Hopkins President Ron Daniels and leadership from the Data Science and AI Institute. We received a non-binding investment indication of roughly $75,000 for about 7 to 8% equity, which we chose not to pursue immediately because we wanted the right long-term partners and product direction.
